settings.title: Are they custom-made for my car ?
settings.content: We will customize for each car model.We don't sell universal model.

settings.title: Do the rear seat covers accommodate a split bench or a full bench seat ?
settings.content: They accommodate a split bench, specifically 60/40 and even 40/20/40 to be precise.

settings.title: Do you offer a seat cover for the middle front seat, armrests and console ?
settings.content: Absolutely Yes! Our "Bundle Set" will include the middle front seat,armrests and console too.

settings.title: What is material of your car seat covers ?
settings.content: They are made from premium Nappa leather. This material is durable, breathable and gives a luxurious look and feel.

settings.title: Are the seat covers breathable and comfortable during long drives ?
settings.content: Absolutely! We've incorporated breathable cushioning for cool comfort in any climate.

settings.title: What is the different of your seat covers with other brands ?
settings.content: Our seat cover was custom-made for customer car model.Especially, we will give customer 2 Free Neck Pillows.

settings.title: How easy are these seats to install ?
settings.content: The installation process is quite simple. With just simple steps that typically take around 15 minutes.

settings.title: Can I install it by myself ?
settings.content: Absolutely! Our seat covers are designed with no special tool. You can install it at home by yourself.

settings.title: Is there a guide or manual available for installation ?
settings.content: Yes, we provide multiple resources for installation guidance. You can access a video guide and a PDF manual. Additionally, a paper manual is included in every package.

settings.title: How long does shipping take?
settings.content: You will receive your order within 7-15 days as we need extra time to customize for your vehicle.

settings.title: Is Free Shipping available ?
settings.content: Absolutely! We offer Free Shipping across the entire United States.

settings.title: What's about Warranty Policy ?
settings.content: We provide a 2-year warranty and a 30-days free return policy. You can return the product within 30 days if you're not satisfied.
